name: V2L1 — Listening Test 1
rules: Tap Load the recording, then press play. The recording runs about 27 minutes and covers all four sections.
Use the Sec 1–4 buttons to jump straight to a section if you are practising one part only.
Read the instructions above each group of questions carefully — the word limit changes.
Answer all 40 questions, then tap Submit Test for your band score.
A 40-minute timer runs in the background; the test submits itself at zero.
Your answers save automatically on this device if the page reloads.
